clips.title: The story
paras: Carendin Halgar is a prominent Forsaken warlock trainer residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Sharp-tongued and notoriously short on patience, he oversees the training of fledgling practitioners of the dark arts. He instructs aspiring warlocks on how to subjugate powerful demonic entities from the Twisting Nether, notably teaching the rituals to bind Voidwalkers and Succubi.

Within the noxious gloom of the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Carendin Halgar instructs those who delve into the Twisting Nether. He demands focus and obedience, holding little tolerance for failure, hesitation, or weakness. Under his watchful gaze, warlocks are pushed beyond basic incantations into the dangerous mastery of summonings and soul manipulation, cementing the Forsaken's ruthless approach to demonic servitude.
